progressionBeats: Earn first ore from Iron Vein.
Buy Pickaxe Upgrade near the one-minute mark.
Unlock Hire Miners and open Deep Gem Cave.
Reach Gem Prestige by the target session end.

sessionPacing.earlyGame: Spawn in Surface Claim, learn income, and buy the first upgrade within 45–90 seconds.
sessionPacing.midGame: Route through Furnace Row to add automation and unlock the gated area.
sessionPacing.lateGame: Use Deep Gem Cave for prestige/rebirth setup and creator handoff checks.
